lines.trans: Downstairs in my workshop there is a brass reading lamp.
And I have two soft pillows and a blue rug in the storeroom!
What about the small bathroom next door? Does the light work there?
A new lightbulb last week, clean soap, plenty of hot water.
Give us fifteen minutes, then this attic room will even beat room seven!
Grab the boxes, Werner, off downstairs we go!
Careful on the bend, do not bump into the wall!
